simple.meaning: נְשַׁר (nᵉshar) is a Hebrew word meaning “an eagle.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְשַׁר (H5403) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 4:30, with occurrences in Daniel.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נְשַׁר (H5403) before moving outward to related references.
